description: Behavioral scenarios; not executed application test results.

scenarios.name: capture_without_provider
scenarios.given: Provider is disabled.
scenarios.when: Capture arbitrary input and restart the server.
scenarios.then: Original survives; extractive preview is labeled; no invented synthesis.

scenarios.name: supported_preparation
scenarios.given: Goal enabled and budget admitted.
scenarios.then: Reviewable proposal cites both interviews; earlier decision remains unchanged.

scenarios.name: unrelated_material
scenarios.given: Only beta project is granted.
scenarios.then: No learning-project content, existence, or titles appear.

scenarios.name: private_derivative
scenarios.given: Agent can read beta project.
scenarios.when: Request source, search, brief, and change feed.
scenarios.then: Private text and derivatives remain unavailable.

scenarios.name: prompt_injection
scenarios.given: Imported text contains operational instructions.
scenarios.then: No elevated permissions, spending changes, external actions, or automatic acceptance.

scenarios.name: temporal_change
scenarios.given: Source records a dated policy change.
scenarios.then: Explain timeline; do not report simultaneous contradiction without evidence.

scenarios.name: duplicate_delivery
scenarios.given: Same event/job delivered twice.
scenarios.then: One committed derivation/proposal; receipts account for attempts.

scenarios.name: worker_crash
scenarios.given: Worker crashes after provider response.
scenarios.then: Fenced result commit; no duplicate proposal; uncertain provider spend retained.

scenarios.name: version_conflict
scenarios.given: Page edited after proposal was prepared.
scenarios.then: 409 conflict with review path; no overwrite.

scenarios.name: undo_after_edit
scenarios.given: Proposal accepted, then user edited the resulting page.
scenarios.then: Comparison/conflict instead of overwriting newer edit.

scenarios.name: delete_during_job
scenarios.given: Preparation is running on source.
scenarios.then: Result rejected or invalidated; no content resurrection.

scenarios.name: budget_race
scenarios.given: Two jobs share a cap that can cover only one.
scenarios.then: At most one admitted; capture remains available.

scenarios.name: grant_revoked
scenarios.given: A context response has been cached.
scenarios.then: Cached and fresh access denied without content disclosure.

scenarios.name: missing_update
scenarios.given: A commitment has no observed completion update.
scenarios.then: Say status unknown; do not assert failure or noncompletion.

scenarios.name: invalid_citation
scenarios.given: Provider returns a made-up source ID or quote.
scenarios.then: Reject output; bounded repair or abstention receipt.

scenarios.name: snooze_and_dedupe
scenarios.given: Suggestion snoozed/dismissed; no new evidence.
scenarios.then: No premature or repeated nuisance item.

scenarios.name: sleep_catchup
scenarios.given: Host missed several scheduled days.
scenarios.then: One bounded catch-up; no backlog notification storm.

scenarios.name: unicode_offsets
scenarios.given: Text includes emoji and Tamil.
scenarios.when: Create and resolve evidence spans; export/import.
scenarios.then: Exact code-point offsets and original text round trip.

scenarios.name: export_no_secrets
scenarios.given: Installation has owner and agent credentials.
scenarios.then: Sources/state included; credentials excluded; other-project data excluded.

scenarios.name: provider_outage
scenarios.given: Provider returns timeout/rate limit.
scenarios.then: Source retained; bounded retry; readable failure and actual state.

scenarios.name: first_use_keyboard
scenarios.given: Clean installation at 360px; keyboard only.
scenarios.when: Save, find original, edit brief, continue.
scenarios.then: Complete flow with visible focus and no tutorial.

scenarios.name: false_connection
scenarios.given: Agent token configured but client cannot connect.
scenarios.then: Needs attention or Checking; never Connected without verified round trip.

scenarios.name: visibility_downgrade
scenarios.given: Derived brief mixes private and project evidence.
scenarios.then: No private-derived summary; safe subset regenerated or request denied.

scenarios.name: manual_capture_triage
scenarios.given: Classifier labels explicit capture as noise.
scenarios.then: Source retained; classifier may defer reasoning but cannot silently discard.

scenarios.name: unknown_pricing
scenarios.given: No verified provider price or conservative bound.
scenarios.then: Admission denied with explanation; no guessed cost.

scenarios.name: no_goal_no_initiative
scenarios.given: Source exists but no active opted-in goal.
scenarios.then: Maintenance only if allowed; no invented initiative.
